summary: This bill allows physical therapists to use "locum tenens" arrangements, which permit temporary substitute practitioners to bill under the absent therapist's provider number, for outpatient physical therapy services under Medicare.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the ability of physical therapists to utilize locum tenens arrangements under Medicare, which could improve access to physical therapy services for Medicare beneficiaries. This is a minor expansion of public healthcare access within an existing framework.

The bill amends Medicare (title XVIII of the Social Security Act) to permit physical therapists to use locum tenens arrangements, a minor expansion of provider flexibility within a major government health program. This is a narrow, technical change whose primary purpose is continuity of care rather than cost reduction or coverage expansion, making any link to affordability tangential at most.
